title: Xplosive Dogs
description: A simple datapack to equip explosives to wolves (without hurting them)
body:
**[English description]:**

Ever wanted to equip a TNT to your wolf pet without the risk of losing your little buddy?
Wait no more!

XplosiveDogs Datapack contains a simple way to equip explosives to tamed wolves!
Just throw a TNT block next to them and it will be equipped, if the wolf starts attacking hostile mobs
it will explode after a few seconds (without resulting hurt!)

**Custom command:**
/trigger explosive_info (will show a menu on chat)

this datapack contains two languages! (more coming soon)(?)
Will be updated soon...


**[Spanish description]:**

¿Alguna vez has querido equipar a tu lobo mascota con una TNT sin el riesgo de perderlo para siempre?
!Pues no esperes más!

XplosiveDogs Datapack Cuenta con una forma simple de equipar explosivos a los lobos domesticados!
Solo lanza un bloque de TNT cerca y se equipará automáticamente, si el lobo comienza a atacar mobs hostiles
explotará luego de pocos segundos (sin resultar herido!)

**Comando personalizado:**
/trigger explosive_info (mostrará un menú del datapack)

Este datapack contiene dos idiomas (más próximamente)(?)
Se actualizará pronto...


Join my discord community to get updates and more content I made for minecraft!
